shortdesc.ph: Network path types used in multipath transmission.
Types of network paths used for multipath transmission.
Network path types used in multipath transmission.

plentry.pd: (0): Local Area Network (LAN) path.
(1): Wi-Fi path.
(2): Mobile network path.
(99): Unknown or unspecified network path.
(0): LAN type, indicating data is transmitted over a local area network, suitable for high-speed, low-latency connections.
(1): Wi-Fi type, indicating data is transmitted over a Wi-Fi network, suitable for wireless connections with moderate latency.
(2): Mobile network type, indicating data is transmitted over a mobile network, suitable for high-latency and unstable connections.
(99): Unknown type, indicating an unrecognized path type, can be used for error handling or fallback scenarios.
